title: Civil mediation centres: caseload, 2024
bodyMd: The table reports the work of four regional civil mediation centres during 2024. "Cases resolved" counts cases closed by agreement during the year; "average days to resolution" is measured over the cases resolved.

data.caption: Cases received, cases resolved, average days to resolution and number of mediators at four regional civil mediation centres in 2024.

accessibilityText: A table with five columns — centre, cases received, cases resolved, average days to resolution, and mediators — and four rows. Arno received 1,200 cases, resolved 900, averaged 40 days and had 12 mediators. Brenta received 800 cases, resolved 600, averaged 25 days and had 10 mediators. Chienti received 450 cases, resolved 360, averaged 30 days and had 6 mediators. Dora received 1,500 cases, resolved 900, averaged 50 days and had 15 mediators.

provenance.notes: Invented data. The centre names, counts and staffing figures are fictional and were chosen to give clean arithmetic; they do not describe any real mediation service.
